I grew up in Massachusetts playing soccer as my only sport. I started playing club at age 10, rotating through various field positions until I was 14. At that point, I made the move to goalkeeper while playing for SF Vikings and joined Aztec Soccer Club shortly after.
In high school, I played three years of varsity at Masconomet Regional after a year on JV. During that time, we played in two Division 2 North Finals, and I was named to the All-Conference team my senior year. I also continued playing with Aztec from my sophomore through senior year, competing in the NPSL.
After graduating, I was recruited to play for Salve Regina University. My freshman year was the 2020 "Covid year," so our schedule was limited. During my sophomore season, I began earning time on the field, but my year was cut short by a season-ending injury during practice. I took some time away from the team during my junior year to recover and figure out my next steps, but I quickly realized how much I missed the game. I returned for my senior season, where I shared time in net with a 3rd year goalkeeper through the end of the year.
Currently, I’m living in Newport and coaching soccer at our local middleschool. Soccer is a major part of my life, and I’m looking to continue both playing and coaching at a competitive level for the foreseeable future.
